Applications are invited for appointment as a Visiting Medical Officer in Emergency Medicine at Prince of Wales Hospital for the quinquennium period: 1 July 2027 to 30 June 2032.
 

An eligibility list may be created for vacancies on an ongoing basis (following this advertisement).

The vision for South Eastern Sydney Local Health District (SESLHD) is 'exceptional people, healthier lives'. SESLHD is committed to enabling our community to be healthy and well, and to providing the best possible compassionate care when people need it. 

The specialist will provide expert medical assessment and management of patients within the department-service. 

The primary location of this position may be varied as agreed with the Director of Medical Services and as approved by MDAAC to other facilities in SESLHD. 

Our CORE Values are Collaboration, Openness, Respect and Empowerment and have been created by employees for employees and help define how we work and to inspire positive interactions in the workplace. 

Learn more about us here: South Eastern Sydney Local Health District 

Information for applicants: 
 

Employment of a temporary visa holder may only occur if no suitable permanent resident or citizen of Australia has been identified for this position following suitable labour market testing.

This is a Category A position. All Category A applicants must read and understand NSW Health Policy PD2026_004. Successful applicants to the role must provide vaccination history and pathology as part of the application documentation and be certified as compliant before employment can commence. 

SESLHD is committed to creating a workplace that reflects the diversity of our community. This will help ensure our employees, our patients and their carers, feel supported. We invite candidates of all ages, genders, sexual orientation, cultural backgrounds, people with disability, neurodiverse individuals, and Indigenous Australians to apply. We do have an Aboriginal Employment Consultant that can also provide support (SESLHD-AboriginalWorkforce@health.nsw.gov.au) and for additional information please visit our Stepping Up Website.

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 

 

All applications must include a demonstration of your ability to meet each of the selection criteria in order to progress through the recruitment process.

Registration or eligible for registration with Medical Board of Australia (AHPRA). Candidate to provide on application AHPRA Registration Number.

Fellowship, or eligible for Fellowship prior to July 2027, of the Australasian College for Emergency Medicine (FACEM) and-or equivalent specialist recognition as provided for by the Health Insurance Act 1973 and the relevant Determination.

Evidence of continuing medical education and self-monitoring-audit practices consistent with the scope of practice requirements of the position.

Proven capacity and-or experience in the provision of effective high quality service in the specialty, demonstrated through successful clinical practice in an environment appropriate to the requirements of the position including evidence of participation in quality improvement activities relevant to the specialty.

Demonstrated commitment to teaching with experience in teaching both undergraduate and post graduate students and other staff of the hospital.

Demonstrate the skills and attitudes appropriate as a senior Medical Practitioner including modelling a high standard of professional behaviour to junior medical and dental staff.

Demonstrated ability to work effectively and harmoniously with medical and other health services colleagues as part of a multi-disciplinary health care team and demonstrated ability to communicate effectively with patients, colleagues, and staff and to work as an effective member of the clinical team across multiple sites. Demonstrated commitment to provision of a high standard of clinical care in the public sector setting.

Demonstrated experience in and commitment to research relevant to the role and needs of the Department.

Please complete the attached documentation pack and ensure they are uploaded to your application.

Current Authority to Practice as a Registered Nurse with the Australian Health Practitioner Regulation Agency (AHPRA).

The Staff Specialist Paediatrician provides consultant-level clinical care across acute inpatient, neonatal, emergency, outpatient, ambulatory, and short stay paediatric services at Shoalhaven Memorial Hospital, in line with the hospital's role delineation.

The role includes responsibility for acute paediatric inpatient care, neonatal care within the Special Care Nursery, Emergency care in the mixed ED, supervision and education of junior medical staff and medical students, participation in outreach services, and active contribution to clinical and corporate governance. The position supports the District's commitment to high-quality, safe, patient-centred care and medical education, with potential academic affiliation to the University of Wollongong.

For more information and to view the position classification, see the Position Description

A little about us.

Shoalhaven Memorial Hospital is the main referral hospital for the Shoalhaven region, providing emergency care, medical, surgical and orthopaedic services. The hospital has an Intensive Care Unit focusing on high dependency and coronary patients, Children's Ward and Maternity Unit, as well as a purpose-built regional Cancer Care Centre.

The hospital is currently undergoing a significant $440M redevelopment that will redefine how healthcare is delivered within the Region. Once complete in mid-2026, the new seven-storey Acute Services Building and refurbishments on the current hospital site will bring a focus on career development. allowing you to grow your career, acquire new skills and advance professionally as the hospital continues to develop. There has never been a better time to join the progressive and expanding team in the Shoalhaven providing the highest standard of care to the Shoalhaven community.

To find out more about the redevelopment, visit our website or watch the flythrough of the new hospital here.

There are many benefits of living and working in the Shoalhaven. The region is home to some of Australia's most beautiful beaches, waterways and National Parks - with Jervis Bay and Kangaroo Valley only a short, 20-minute drive away - and is also host to many annual food and arts festivals and events.

Benefits of working with ISLHD.

We understand that balancing career aspirations with the demand of the everyday, as well as maintaining a healthy work-life balance, can be a challenge. To help with this, we offer a range of benefits which include:

-Training, Education and Study Leave (TESL) - up to $40,400 and 25 calendar days

-Up to 5 weeks annual leave

-Salary packaging- less tax and more take-home pay

-Fitness Passport - discounted gym membership that both you and your family can enjoy (eligible employees)

-Employee Assistance Program (EAP) - free confidential and professional assistance for staff and their families

-Career progression, professional development and secondment opportunities

Apply now by reading the Position Description, then, using our online portal, submit a resume and answer the selection criteriawithin the application. In addition, please note you must have the following essential requirements:

-Applicable vaccination requirements for a Category A role

-Current AHPRA Registration and Fellowship with Royal Australian and New Zealand College of Physicians (FRACP)

-Working With Children Check (WWCC)

-Valid NSW Drivers Licence

We are recruiting for a permanent 1.0 FTE along with a temporary part time (0.6FTE) position, from 7 September 2026 to 11 January 2027

The Department of Vascular Surgery
The Vascular Surgery Department is a tertiary referral centre for vascular surgery. The Vascular unit works collaboratively with other key teams including the vascular geriatrics service, high risk foot and wound clinics. The Concord Institute of Academic Surgery supports research and quality improvement programs in vascular surgery including supervision of higher degrees in research. You will also have the opportunity to participate in Concord Hospital's Surgical Early Education and Development (SEED) mentoring program for unaccredited surgical trainees.
 
Vascular services include:
- Upper and lower limb revascularisation
- Leg ulcer management
- Diabetes-related foot disease management and surgery
- Repair of Abdominal Aortic Aneurysm (Open or Endoluminal)
- Carotid surgery
- Renal Access surgery and maintenance
- Varicose Vein management including endovenous therapy
- Amputation

Where you will be working:
Concord Repatriation General Hospital is a principal referral facility and a teaching hospital of the University of Sydney. We offer a comprehensive range of specialty and sub-specialty services, many recognised nationally and internationally as Centre's of excellence. Major services include colorectal and laparoscopic surgery, gastroenterology, geriatrics and rehabilitation medicine, bone and joint services, cancer services, haematology, respiratory medicine and sleep studies, molecular biology and genetics, and those provided through the internationally acknowledged Statewide Burns Service, in which Concord plays a major part. Concord Hospital maintains string links to the veteran community. the Concord Institute of Academic Surgery provides support for surgical research and education.

result.description: BRIC Consulting Engineers  BRIC Consulting Engineers is looking for a full-time Civil Engineering Technician to join our team.   Benefits  The remuneration for this position is AU$75,000 - AU$85,000 per annum plus superannuation.   Task & responsibilities  - Assisting Civil Engineering Professionals with the planning, design and delivery of residential, civil and commercial engineering projects by providing technical support throughout project lifecycles.  - Conducting field inspections and site investigations to obtain engineering data, verify existing site conditions and identify issues relevant to the preparation and implementation of engineering designs.  - Performing tests and evaluations of construction materials, including soil, aggregates and concrete, and recording, interpreting and reporting test results to support engineering assessments and compliance requirements.  - Collecting, analysing and tabulating engineering, survey and construction data to assist in the preparation of technical reports, design calculations and project documentation.  - Preparing engineering sketches, technical drawings and computer-aided design (CAD) documentation based on engineering specifications, project requirements and applicable Australian Standards.  - Assisting in the preparation and revision of civil engineering plans, layouts, details and supporting documentation to facilitate construction activities and regulatory approvals.  - Monitoring construction activities and inspecting works to verify conformity with approved drawings, engineering specifications, contractual requirements and relevant statutory regulations.  - Assisting in the identification, investigation and resolution of technical issues arising during design development and construction by liaising with engineers, contractors and other project stakeholders.  - Preparing quantity estimates, material schedules and cost information to support project planning, procurement activities and budget estimations.  - Reviewing engineering documentation, specifications and technical submissions to verify completeness, accuracy and compliance with project and regulatory requirements.  - Maintaining accurate project records, inspection reports, testing results and technical documentation in accordance with organisational procedures and quality management requirements.  - Coordinating with surveyors, architects, contractors, local authorities and utility service providers to facilitate project delivery and ensure effective communication between stakeholders.  - Supporting the implementation of workplace health and safety, environmental and quality assurance procedures during site inspections and project execution.  - Assisting with the preparation of engineering reports, technical correspondence and client documentation by presenting engineering information in a clear, accurate and professional manner.      Qualification & experience  Qualifications  - AQF Diploma or Advanced Diploma in Civil Engineering, Civil Engineering Design, Engineering Technology, or a closely related discipline.  - A higher qualification, such as a Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering or a related discipline, will be considered favourably but is not essential.    Experience  - At least 1 year experience in a civil engineering, structural engineering or engineering consultancy environment.    Skills  - Civil engineering and construction knowledge.  - Technical drawing and CAD proficiency.  - Engineering data collection, analysis and reporting.  - Construction materials testing and quantity estimating.  - Interpretation of engineering drawings and specifications.  -Effective communication and organisational skills.  About Company    BRIC Consulting Engineers is a privately-owned Australian Structural, Civil and Commercial Engineering Consultancy based in Rivervale, Western Australia. Since 2020, we’ve delivered engineering services on thousands of residential, civil and commercial projects across Western Australia. From small-scale developments to complex commercial government projects, our focus is simple: practical, cost-effective and compliant engineering solutions that work in the real world.         Work Type:  Full time   Salary:  $75000-85000   Job Publish:  09-07-2026   Job Expire:  08-08-2026   Apply Link:  https://workinitiatives.com.au/job/details?id=6005106   This job is brought to you by workinitiatives.com.au.
